docs.title: Hướng dẫn sử dụng — Vạn An Enterprise Operating Model (Digital Twin)
docs.text: Twin = lớp tài liệu truy vấn được của hệ sinh thái. Model captured at 64789992 (2026-11-07).

docs.title: 1. Xem tài liệu (3 cách)
docs.text: Cách Lệnh Phù hợp HTML portal python -m mkdocs build -f docs/mkdocs-twin.yml → python -m http.server 8765 -d docs/twin-portal-site Đọc, search, xem mermaid render — owner/HTX operator GitHub/IDE Mở trực tiếp .md trong repo Dev đọc nhanh, review PR Truy vấn YAML Đọc/grep registries/*.yaml Trả lời câu hỏi có cấu trúc

docs.title: 2. Trả lời câu hỏi thường gặp
docs.text: Câu hỏi Nhìn vào Ai làm activity này, manual hay auto? registries/activities.yaml → tìm ACTV-xxx Module/API/bảng nào đứng sau nghiệp vụ X? 10-digital-twin/traceability-matrix.md Dữ liệu này lưu ở đâu, SoT là gì? registries/data-entities.yaml (systemOfRecord) + 05-data-architecture/ Ai duyệt bước này? 06-governance/approval-matrix.md Đã implement chưa hay mới ý định? field confidence + implStatus trong registry; 07-as-is/ Nên tự động hóa gì tiếp? 09-gap-analysis/automation-gap-register.md + roadmap Deploy HTX mới cần gì? 03-processes/process-catalog.md (CORE vs VARIANT) + F4 swimlane

docs.title: 3. Kiểm tra tính toàn vẹn
docs.text:
python scripts/validate-twin.py        # 6 checks: ID, required fields, refs, enums, evidence, coverage
python scripts/twin-drift-report.py    # code vs twin drift → 11-validation/drift-report.md

Warnings (không phải errors) là findings hợp lệ: activity không có software link, risk chưa có control.

docs.title: 4. Quy tắc khi đọc
docs.text:
• registries/*.yaml = single source of truth; file .md chỉ là narrative — nếu lệch nhau, tin YAML.
  • Evidence path@commit-sha — click sang file code tương ứng để verify. Entry nào không re-verify được = STALE.
  • Confidence: VERIFIED (code-proven) → INFERRED → ASSUMED (chờ owner). Status: ACTIVE → PROPOSED → APPROVED → RETIRED.
  • ID không đổi: ACTR actor, PROC process, ACTV activity, SYS component, RULE, CTRL, RISK, GAP...

docs.title: 5. Cập nhật twin (2-tier — 10-digital-twin/maintenance-rules.md)
docs.text:
• Mandatory (cùng change batch): đổi business rule/flow, permission, tenant boundary, NATS subject, voucher type mới, AI boundary → update registries + diagram liên quan.
  • Conditional (registry touch-up): endpoint nội bộ mới, refactor, entity không ảnh hưởng process → chỉ thêm dòng YAML.
  • Chạy validate-twin.py sau mỗi sửa; chạy twin-drift-report.py định kỳ để bắt drift.

docs.title: 6. Không được làm
docs.text:
• Không sửa ID đã gán (retire bằng status: RETIRED).
  • Không ghi ASSUMED như VERIFIED; unknown → unresolved-questions.md.
  • Không đưa secrets/PII thật vào docs (NFR-07).
  • Không xóa/ghi đè docs hiện có ngoài enterprise-operating-model/ (twin INDEXES, không absorb).

docs.title: Diagram Conventions — Vạn An Enterprise Operating Model
docs.text: Normative reference for ALL diagrams in this twin. SRS v2.1 §5.3, §6.2, §6.4, §9.1. Mermaid must render (AC-11). Never mix conventions within one diagram.

docs.title: 1. Execution-type colors (SRS §5.3 — mandatory classDef)
docs.text:
Copy this block into every flowchart/swimlane:

flowchart TB
    classDef human fill:#cfe3ff,stroke:#2b6cb0,color:#1a365d
    classDef auto fill:#c6f6d5,stroke:#2f855a,color:#22543d
    classDef hybrid fill:#feebc8,stroke:#c05621,color:#7b341e
    classDef external fill:#e2e8f0,stroke:#718096,color:#2d3748
    classDef error fill:#fed7d7,stroke:#c53030,color:#742a2a
    classDef ai fill:#c6f6d5,stroke:#2f855a,stroke-dasharray:5 5,color:#22543d
Type Color classDef Meaning Human activities Blue human One human performs one action Automated Green auto System performs, no human in that step Hybrid Amber hybrid ONE atomic step, inseparable human+software output (rare — see §3) External systems Grey external Third-party/government Errors/exceptions Red error Failure, blocked, rejected paths AI agents Green + dashed ai Advisory AI (vanan-ai, LLM parsers) — see §5 boundary

docs.title: 2. Diagram types — distinct questions (SRS §6.2)
docs.text: Diagram Question When required Swimlane flowchart Who does what / where responsibility sits Mandatory for every critical process (§6.5) Flowchart (no lanes) Sequence of steps/decisions Any workflow Sequence diagram Technical interaction over time API/NATS/service handoffs — complements, never replaces swimlanes

docs.title: Swimlane rule (Mermaid has no native swimlanes)
docs.text:
flowchart TB
    subgraph CUST["ACTR-001 — Customer"]
        direction TB
        A1["Place order"]:::human
    end
    subgraph GW["SYS-002 — Gateway"]
        direction TB
        A2["Create order in PG"]:::auto
    end
    A1 --> A2
  • One subgraph per lane; lane title = ID — name; each subgraph direction TB.
  • Cross-lane edges = handoffs. Only participating actors get lanes.
  • If a critical flow needs both views, produce swimlane + sequenceDiagram as two linked artifacts sharing ACTV-/API- IDs.

docs.title: 3. Execution classification — decompose-first (SRS §5.1)
docs.text: Before assigning HYBRID, split into MANUAL + AUTOMATED activities joined by a handoff/approval gate. HYBRID is correct ONLY for a single atomic step where human and software co-produce one output (e.g., Smart Entry interactive parsing). "Software detects → human reviews" is TWO activities, not HYBRID.

docs.title: 4. Flowchart completeness (SRS §6.3)
docs.text: Every workflow must show: start/end events, triggers, human+automated+hybrid actions, decisions, data in/out, approval gates, exception/error paths, external dependencies, handoffs, responsible parties. Happy-path-only is insufficient.

docs.title: 5. AI actors (SRS §7.4)
docs.text: AI activities use classDef ai and must state: advisory vs executing, authoritative data source, tenant isolation scope, metering link.

docs.title: 6. Evidence format (SRS §9.1 — mandatory on every AS-IS claim)
docs.text:
<repo-relative-path>@<commit-sha>     preferred — e.g. 2_Gateway/Controllers/OrdersController.cs@64789992
<repo-relative-path>#L<start>-<end>   fallback when commit impractical (line refs decay — note it)
none:<reason>                         explicit no-evidence marker

Every evidence-register entry records the repo commit SHA at capture time. A claim that cannot be re-verified at HEAD is flagged STALE — never silently trusted.

docs.title: Reading guide
docs.text:
• Option C data spine: Customer → Gateway (PG SoT) → NATS vanan.cloud.order.created.{shopInstanceId} → ShopERP ; status sync returns via vanan.shoperp.*.
  • Tenant boundary: each merchant = separate SQLite + ShopInstance routing entry; HTX = tenant class with HtxProfile + TT71 regime.
  • AI boundary (§7.4): vanan-ai is advisory — suggests into existing flows; never creates orders/records; metered (ai.chat.message).
  • Registry IDs on nodes are navigable: look up SYS-004 in registries/components.yaml, ACTR-002 in registries/actors.yaml.

docs.title: Existing Documentation Index & Deduplication Decisions — Phase 0
docs.text:
SRS §14-P0, §16.7: twin indexes existing docs, does not duplicate or absorb them. Decision per cluster: INDEX (twin links to it, keep as-is) · SUPERSEDE (twin restates — must record why) · GAP (topic has no adequate doc). Captured at 64789992 — docs/ ≈ 766 .md files; below is cluster-level triage, not per-file.

Cluster Path Decision Note Requirements & SRS docs/requirements/ (~30 files) INDEX Business intent source — twin references for TO-BE/context; never restates Formal specs docs/specs/ (accounting engine, voucher framework, loyalty) INDEX Authoritative specs — link from registries as evidence AI working docs docs/AI/ (project_state, plans, tasks, guides) INDEX Execution history — twin links master plans for module context Architecture docs/Architecture/ (ADRs, monolithic arch, DB docs w/ mermaid) INDEX Contains DB docs + mermaid — P3 mines for data model Feature guides docs/*_Guide*.md, *_Documentation.md (ShopERP, KhachLink, admin, mobile, UI platform) INDEX User/dev docs — link as narrative evidence Process docs docs/QuyTrinh/, docs/HopTacXa/, docs/IMPLEMENTATION/, docs/Implement/ INDEX Business process descriptions — P2 mines for actor/workflow discovery MVP/design docs/MVP_Product/, docs/design/ (use-case docs w/ mermaid) INDEX Historical design intent — ASSUMED-level evidence Decisions docs/decisions/ INDEX ADR-style — authoritative for "why" Diagnostics/archive docs/diagnostics/, docs/requirements/archive/, docs/AI/archive_tasks.md INDEX Historical only — exclude from AS-IS evidence Loose root files docs/*.md flat (SQLite fix plans, module designs…) INDEX Case-by-case linking; some overlap w/ twin scope Digital Twin docs/enterprise-operating-model/ — This project

docs.title: Dedup rules applied
docs.text:
1. No existing doc is moved/renamed/deleted (§16.8).
  2. Twin files reference existing docs by path@commit, never copy their content.
  3. Where two docs conflict on AS-IS fact → code wins, discrepancy logged in evidence-register §C.
  4. SUPERSEDE requires explicit owner authorization — none granted at P0, so zero SUPERSEDE decisions made.

docs.title: Glossary & ID Conventions — Vạn An Enterprise Operating Model
docs.text: SRS v2.1 §4.1, §5, §6.5, §6.6, §7.4, §11.1. Single reference for terms used across the twin.

docs.title: Execution types (per atomic activity — §5.1)
docs.text: Term Definition MANUAL One human performs one action AUTOMATED One system performs one action, no human in that execution HYBRID ONE atomic step co-produced by inseparable human+software interaction (rare — decompose first)

docs.title: Actor types (§4.1)
docs.text: Type Meaning ID HUMAN Individual performing an activity ACTR- ORGANIZATION Legal entity/cooperative — organizations register ONLY in organizations.yaml (ORG-), never dual-registered (§4.4) ORG- SOFTWARE Application, service, module, automated agent ACTR- AI AGENT SOFTWARE subtype with probabilistic/advisory output — carries §7.4 boundary attributes ACTR- (type=AI_AGENT) EXTERNAL SYSTEM Third-party or government platform ACTR- HYBRID Combined human/software operational role ACTR-

docs.title: Confidence scale (§5.2)
docs.text: Level Meaning VERIFIED Confirmed against executable code, schema, API surface or test INFERRED Strongly indicated by docs/naming, not directly verified in code ASSUMED Business expectation — requires owner confirmation

docs.title: Critical process (§6.5) — ANY of:
docs.text:
1. Creates/modifies/reverses financial or accounting records.
  2. Crosses a tenant or organization boundary.
  3. Crosses a deployment boundary (multi-VPS, service-to-service).
  4. Requires approval, produces audit evidence, or is reversible.
  5. Gates revenue (metering deny/allow) or exposes tenant data to AI retrieval.
  6. Failure creates regulatory, tax or data-loss exposure.

docs.title: Process variability (§6.6)
docs.text: Class Meaning CORE Mandatory standard — identical for every HTX/tenant CONFIGURABLE Same process, behavior varied by configuration (e.g., TenantFeatureSettings) VARIANT Differs by business type/HTX model — MUST have parentRef to a CORE process, documents only deltas

docs.title: ID scheme (§11.1) — stable, never renumbered; retired items get status RETIRED, never reuse
docs.text: ACTR actor · ORG organization · CAP capability · PROC process · ACTV activity · SYS software component · API api/integration · DATA data entity · RULE business rule · CTRL control · RISK risk · KPI kpi · GAP gap

docs.title: Status values
docs.text: ACTIVE (verified/current) · PROPOSED (TO-BE awaiting owner sign-off) · RETIRED

docs.title: Data terms
docs.text:
• System of record (SoT): authoritative store for a data item — Gateway PG (Orders/Accounting/Tenants/ShopInstances/Users/FeaturedProducts), ShopERP SQLite (Products/POS ops), metering DB (wallets/usage), vanan-ai PG (knowledge).
  • Replica/cache: derived copy (e.g., ShopERP order replica for kitchen/POS).

docs.title: AI boundary (§7.4)
docs.text:
• Advisory vs executing: AI suggests into existing flows; it never creates orders/journal entries/business records.
  • Authoritative source: structured tenant data beats vector-retrieved knowledge on conflict.
  • Tenant isolation: retrieval scoped by signed tenant context.
  • Approval gate: knowledge pending_review → approved before public retrieval.
  • Degrade: metering deny/fail → configured degrade/refuse path.

docs.title: Evidence format (§9.1)
docs.text: path@commit-sha (preferred) · path#L<n> (decays, note it) · none:<reason>. Entries record capture-commit; unverifiable → STALE.

ResolveEffective = override-if-allowed → default-if-allowed → allowed[0] → null. AccountingStandardResolver (ShopERP) thin-wraps for UI dropdown labels.
  • Write-path: TenantManagementService.SetAccountingStandardAsync validates AllowedStandards(tenant.Type, s).Contains(s) — write-path rejects out-of-lock standard.
  • HKD books: HKDBookService exposes S1a/S2a/S2b/S2c/S2d/S2e/S3a generation (industrySector hint for S2a/S2b per TT 152); HKDBookGenerationService runs HKDBookTemplates + GetAvailableTemplatesAsync/ValidateTemplateAsync/GetGenerationStatusAsync; exposed via GET /api/hkd-books (RequireTenantAccess).
  • Trial balance (VAS W4): per-account opening (EntryDate < periodStart) + movement (in-period) → signed balance; IsBalanced = |ΣNợ−ΣCó| < 0.01. Loads entries < periodEnd into memory — Pattern #1/#5 fixed (direct TenantId compare + EntryDate range).
  • GL reports (P0.2): GeneralLedgerService — Nhật ký chung (full-period journal list), Sổ Cái (opening + cumulative movement + closing per account), balances per account — read-only on JournalEntry (double-entry, BCTC regimes).

docs.title: Verified mechanics

• Store split: stock entities (StockMovementEntity, Ingredient, InventoryCount, ShiftAlert) live on ShopERPDbContext (SQLite per-tenant) — business data, not accounting. PurchaseReceipt voucher lives on PG. Link = Id references only, no physical FK (cross-DB).

ApplyReceiptStockAsync writes PurchaseIn per line with IngredientId, bumps CurrentStock, sets PricePerUnit = latest purchase cost (user decision), stamps StockAppliedAt. ApplyReturnStockAsync writes PurchaseReturn, allows negative stock (goods consumed before return). Idempotency key: (PurchaseReceiptId, PurchaseReceiptLineId, MovementType) — retry never double-applies.
  • Stock truth: StockMovement = audit SoT (Quantity always positive; direction from MovementType 6 values: PurchaseIn/Return, ManualIn/Out, AdjustmentIn/Out). CurrentStock = snapshot/cache. GetStockReportAsync rebuilds Nhập–Xuất–Tồn: baseline = CurrentStock − Σmovements → opening/closing correct even for stock predating the movement table.
  • Manual ops: RecordManualAsync (ManualIn/ManualOut) on /inventory/ingredients; out > stock → InvalidOperationException. ListMovementsAsync for drill-down/card view.
  • Count: InventoryCount per shift×ingredient (CountType, base unit, MidShiftStockIn restock accumulation); Update/AddRestock allowed only while shift Draft/Submitted — blocked after Closed (NFR-7).
  • Alerts: shift close → AlertEngine (10 rules, IAlertRule implementations) → ShiftAlert (ING_VARIANCE_HIGH, STOCK_LOW, …, severity + variance value/%, resolve tracking) — in-app default; TelegramAlertNotifier/ZaloAlertNotifier optional via dispatcher.

SetGlobalModeAsync validates rates 0-1 and fee+fund ≤ 1, rejects global Inherit. Snapshot at order creation → future orders only.

If delegate returns null → warn-log, task still Delivered (no compensating action).

docs.title: MANDATORY update (same change batch or linked task)
docs.text:
Business-visible changes only:

Change Update New/changed business rule or transaction flow RULE + affected ACTV/PROC + diagram New voucher type (VoucherTypeRegistry.AddVoucherType) ACTV + RULE + CTRL + diagram Permission/role/responsibility change authorization-map, approval-matrix, RACI Tenant-boundary or SoT change data-ownership + governance + flows Integration behavior change (NATS subject, sync direction, external contract) apis.yaml + integration-map New actor-facing workflow or approval gate process-catalog + swimlane + RACI AI boundary change (new intent/knowledge class/policy, advisory→executing) §7.4 attrs + CTRL/RISK

docs.title: CONDITIONAL update (registry touch-up only — no diagram churn)
docs.text:
Change Update New internal API endpoint apis.yaml if referenced by modeled activity; else defer Refactor/rename inside a module update evidence refs only if component already referenced New entity/table, no process impact data-entities.yaml row only Internal service/helper added SYS entry only if it crosses a documented boundary

Neither tier touched → no twin update. Honest scope: validator checks link integrity + coverage, not semantic equivalence vs code — semantic drift is caught by drift-detector (EOM-X0) + periodic re-verification.
